[लिश्-घञ्] 
__1 A small bit or portion, a particle, an atom, a very small quantity; क्लेश (v. l. स्वेद)-लेशैरभिन्नम् [[Ś. 2. 4]]; श्रमबारिलेशैः [[

]]; so भक्ति°, गुण° &c. 
__2 Smallness, littleness. 
__3 A measure of time (equal to two kalās). 
__4 (In Rhet.) A figure of speech which consists in representing what is usually considered as an advantage to be a disadvantage and vice versa. It is thus defined in [[R. G.]]:--गुणस्यानिष्टसाधनतया दोषत्वेन दोषस्येष्टसाधनतया गुणत्वेन च बर्णनं लेशः; for examples see ad loc. (Mammaṭa appears to include this figure under बिशेष. See [[K.

.]] 
-Comp. 
-उक्त a. only suggested, or hinted at, insinuated.

[लिष्-तुन्] A clod, lump of earth. 
-Comp. 
-भेदनः an instrument for breaking clods.

लेसकः,
लेसिकः A rider of an elephant.
